resources.string: Watches for Accessibility, permissions, and device-admin settings screens being opened on this device, and alerts you with a front-camera photo when they are.
You will be alerted if Accessibility or permission settings are opened
Enable both of the following so Security Watch can alert you when someone opens Accessibility or app-permission settings on this device.

Security Watch only runs on this device, only watches Settings/permission screens, and only stores photos locally on this phone. Nothing is uploaded anywhere. Install this only on a device you own or are authorized to monitor.
